name: DCS-SimpleTextToSpeech (STTS)
summary: Lua helper that speaks text or plays MP3/OGG files over SRS radio frequencies from mission scripts.
description:
Loaded inside a mission with DO SCRIPT or DO SCRIPT FILE, then called via `STTS.TextToSpeech(...)` and `STTS.PlayMP3(...)`. Uses SRS External Audio, so the SRS server must run on the mission host.

Requires: Requires SRS 1.9.6.0+ on the same machine and a desanitized MissionScripting.lua (reapply after each DCS update). Optional Google TTS credentials.
